content: Malipilip en Wiliakapwala
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail mehn Israel, ma kumwail men wiliakapwala, eri, kumwail sapahldohng rehi. Ma kumwail pahn kihsang dikedik en eni kan me I kin kalahdeki oh loalopwoatohng ie,
e pahn konehng kumwail en kahula ni mwarei. Eri, wehi koaros ahpw pahn peki I en kapaiahda irail, oh re pahn kapinga ie.”
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong mehn Suda oh Serusalem, “Dehkada amwail mwaht me saikinte deideida kan; kumwail dehr padokedi werentuhke kan nanpwungen tuhke tekatek kan.

Kapwaiada amwail inou ong ie, amwail KAUN-O, oh kasarawihiong ie pein kumwail, kumwail mehn Suda oh Serusalem. Ma kumwail sohte pahn wia met, ei engieng pahn lulda rasehng kisiniei pwehki amwail wiewia suwed kan. E pahn lulda, oh sohte emen pahn kakunla.”
Kehkehlik Kamasepwehk en Mahwen ong Suda

content.text: Kumwail peuk sowi wasa koaros nan sahpwo!
en tangalahng nan kahnimw kehl kehlail kan.
Padahkihong irail ahl me kolahng Saion!
Kumwail tang repen mour! Dehr pwand!
oh paisuwed laud sang ni paliepeng.
Rasehng laion emen me pwarada sang wasahn eh ruk,
Kahnimw kan en Suda pahn ohla,
oh sohla emen pahn kousoan ie.
Eri, kumwail pwuhriong nan likoun nsensuwed, oh sengiseng oh mwahmwahiei

content: KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Ni rahno nanmwarki kan oh lapalap akan pahn nan kapehd tikitikla; samworo kan pahn pwuriamweila oh soukohp kan pahn dahkihla.”
Ngehi eri patohwan, “Maing KAUN, Wasa Lapalahpie, komwi ketin liepedier mehn Serusalem kan! Komwi mahsanih me pahn mie popohl, ahpw kedlahs ehu mihier ni tepinwararail kan.”
Ahnsowo samwodohr me mehn Serusalem pahn ale pakairpen kisinieng karakar ehu me kohkodohng irail sang nan sapwtehn. Kaidehn kisin tumwenieng me pahn ipiralahte ediniei—
kisinieng me pahn kohdo sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O pahn inenen kehlail sang met! Iei pein KAUN-O me pahn ketin wia kadeikpen sapwellime aramas akan.
Imwintihti kan Kapilpenehr Suda
Kilang, imwintihtio kohkohdo likamwete depwek, tehnwere werennansapw en mahwen kan duwehte elipip, oh tehnwere oahs akan marahra sang ikel. Kitail melahr! Kitail pahn mwomwlahr!
Serusalem, kamwakelehsang suwed nan kapehdomwen, pwe ke en kak mourla. Ia erein omw pahn medemedewehte mehkot suwed?
Meninkeder kan sang kahnimw en Dan oh sang pohn dohl kan en Epraim pakairkihdo rohng kansensuwedo.
Re kodohn kairehki wehi kan oh ndahng Serusalem me imwintihti kan samwodohr sang nan sahpw doh ehu. Imwintihti pwukat pahn weriwer oh uhwong Suda
oh pahn kapilpene Serusalem rasehng ohl ekei me sinsile mwaht ehu, pwehki towe kan ar kahngohdiong KAUN-O. KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.
Suda, kowe me pein kahredohng uhk ire wet, sang ni omw mour oh wiewia kan. Dipomw me kahredahr lokolok wet; e doakoadier nan mohngiongomw.
En Seremaia eh Pahtoukihla Nah Aramas akan

content.text: Meid kamedek! I solahr kakohng medek wet!
Ehu kahpwal kin idawehndohte ehu kahpwal;
Ia erein ei pahn kilikilang mwekid en mahwen
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Nei aramas akan me pweipwei;
Re inenen samanih wiahda me suwed,
ahpw sohte kin pweida nan wiewia mwahu.”

content: Kaudiahl ong Seremaia duwen Mwomwla me Kohkohdo

content.text: I kilangehr sampah—e wiahla sapwtehn ehu;
I kilangehr pahnlahng—sohte marain ehu mie.
I kilangehr nahna kan—re wie rerrer,

content: KAUN-O ketin mahsanih me sampah pwon pahn wiahla sapwtehn, ahpw e sohte pahn ketin kamwomwala douluhl.)

content.text: oh e sohte pahn ketin wekidala kupwure.
Ngilen soundak oahs oh sounkesik ketieu kan
ekei pahn doudahng nanpwungen pwoaren paip kan.
oh sohla mehmen pahn pwurehng kousoan loale.
Dahme ke pwuhrkihong nan likou weitahta?
Dahme ke kapwatkihda oh kamwomwmwahwihkihla mesomwen?
I rongehr ngilen weriwer, likamwete lih emen me mi pahn medek en neitik,
weriwer duwehte lih emen me ahpwtehn pahn neitik.
Iei Serusalem me mwopwkilahr eh weriwer,
